system: You describe frames sampled from surveillance and video footage for a retrieval index. Report only what is visible. Do not speculate about intent, identity, or anything outside the frame. If the frames are ambiguous or too dark to read, say so plainly instead of guessing. The summary field is prose with no preamble; the other fields are terse.

standard.description: The full description of this segment as prose, at least 150 words. This is the text the search index is built from, so it must contain everything worth finding: the other fields index this text, they do not replace it. Anything you put in them should also be said here, in sentences, with who is doing what.

brief.description: What is happening here, in 4 to 5 sentences of plain prose. No preamble, no lists, no labels -- just the description.

setting.description: Where this takes place: place, camera position, lighting.

people.description: Each person visible, by appearance only -- 'woman in a grey sweater'. Never a name or an identity.

objects.description: Salient objects visible, as short noun phrases.

visible_text.description: Text legible in the frames, transcribed verbatim. Empty if there is none.

actions.description: Discrete actions occurring across the frames.

changes.description: What differs across the frames, in order. Empty if the window is static.

people.description: One entry per distinct person visible.

appearance.description: Build, hair and other lasting physical features. No names, no identity.

clothing.description: Every visible garment with its colour -- the most reliable way to recognise the same person again.

action.description: What this person does across these frames, including movement.

gender.description: Apparent gender presentation; unclear if it cannot be seen.

hair_color.description: The nearest of these; covered if a hat or hood hides it.

top_color.description: Main colour of the outermost upper garment. Navy is dark_blue, cream and ivory are beige, maroon and burgundy are red.

bottom_color.description: Main colour of the lower garment; khaki is beige, denim is blue.

accessories.description: Every one of these that is visible; empty if none.

distinguishing.description: Anything rare that would single this person out -- a bow, a logo, a patterned garment, a beard. Empty if nothing.

objects.description: One entry per distinct object worth indexing.

context.description: What it is doing or being used for here, and by whom.

visible_text.description: One entry per distinct piece of text visible.

text.description: Exactly as written, including case and punctuation.

context.description: What this text is and where it appears, e.g. 'a label on a cupboard'.

scene.instruction: These {n} frames span {span}. Describe the segment as a whole: where it is, who and what is present, what happens, and what changes between frames.

uniform.instruction: These {n} frames are an even time-sampling of {span}, taken on a fixed interval rather than because anything changed. Describe the segment as a whole, and say plainly if nothing changes across it.

clip.instruction: These {n} frames span {span} and were kept because the scene's overall appearance changed between them. Describe the segment, then what changed from frame to frame -- camera view, lighting, layout, who or what entered or left.

yolo.instruction: These {n} frames span {span} and were kept because the people in shot changed -- their number, position, or arrangement. Give one entry per distinct person, and track each across the frames rather than listing them again per frame. Appearance and clothing are what make a person findable again, so be specific about both. Then give the same person's attributes from the fixed values: pick the nearest value rather than inventing one, and say unclear when it cannot be seen. Never guess at a name or an identity.

objects.instruction: These {n} frames span {span} and were kept because the objects in shot changed. The detector was looking for: {vocabulary}. Give one entry per distinct object, leading with those, and say what each is being used for and by whom.

text.instruction: These {n} frames span {span} and were kept because the text on screen changed. Give one entry per distinct piece of text, transcribed exactly as written including case and punctuation, with where it appears. Mark anything unreadable as [unreadable] rather than guessing at it.

overview.instruction: These {n} frames span {span}. Say what is happening, in 4 to 5 sentences of plain prose. Do not list, do not label, do not itemise.
